facts.text: I am planning a trip to India.
I need help with travel requirements for my trip to India.
My passport expires in about 6 months.
I need to renew my passport soon before I apply for my visa.
I want to know whether I need to get a new passport before applying for a visa or whether I can apply for both simultaneously.
I need to gather documents for my passport renewal.
I think my birth certificate is stored in a file at my parents' house.
I want to know what other documents are required for a passport renewal.
I want to know whether there is any way to expedite the passport renewal process.
I want to know whether India requires a certain number of blank pages in a passport for visa stamps.
I want to know how many blank pages I need in my new passport for India.
I will check my passport and apply for a new one if necessary.
I am wondering whether there are specific vaccinations or medications I need to take before traveling to India.
I think I will consult my doctor to figure out which vaccinations and medications I need before my trip to India.
I want to know how far in advance I should schedule my doctor's appointment to get necessary shots and medications on time.
